_comment: Story inbox comms - faction handlers giving cross-system orders without an NPC in the room (gap F / Phase 7). Each arrives the frame its content-gate first passes (game/world/dispatch.py); keys are content_gate's vocabulary (a single value each - no AND across two requires_flag). 'dispatch:<id>' is set on receipt and can gate a later one. Delivery is throttled (DISPATCH_SPACING_FRAMES) so a burst trickles in one at a time; still, gate a sequence on story-progress flags that come in order (jumped_to:/beacon_*_lit/act_*) rather than all on one flag.

authority_first_orders.subject: Standing orders
authority_first_orders.body: Induction logged. The Authority underwrites every beacon you light. Fly the lane, file what you find, and remember whose network this was. We will be in contact.

relay_front_kiln.subject: Reactivation front — Kiln
relay_front_kiln.body: The relight signal has reached the Kiln beacon and moved on outward. You are still ahead of it. Barely.

relay_front_verdance.subject: Reactivation front — Verdance
relay_front_verdance.body: The signal has caught Verdance behind you. The Drift's cloud-city registered the handshake this morning and is still arguing about what it means. Keep moving.

relay_front_ossuary.subject: Reactivation front — Ossuary
relay_front_ossuary.body: It reached Ossuary. The Vigil's beacon lit and the Vigil went quiet - no acknowledgement, no traffic. Whatever they think is coming, they are not saying it on an open channel.

relay_front_span.subject: Reactivation front — the Span
relay_front_span.body: The front caught up with you at the core. Every beacon between Halcyon and here is lit now. There is nowhere further ahead of it to be. Whatever happens to the Relay happens at the Span, and it happens with you standing in it.

carrier_open_hand.subject: An open lane, or none at all
carrier_open_hand.body: You have been lighting beacons ahead of the Authority's flag. Some of us have run these lanes for six generations and would like them to stay ungoverned. Carry for us when you can - and there's a run waiting now if you'll take it: a relief load for the Vigil, sitting at our berth on the Canopy Walk at Highcanopy. Ask for the carrier off the Slip. We remember who flies for us.

vigil_warning.subject: What the beacons were for
vigil_warning.body: You have read part of the wall now. Whatever turned the Relay off did it on purpose. Slow the signal if you can. Do not be the one who finishes its run without knowing what it opens.

combine_mobilises.subject: Notice of closure
combine_mobilises.body: The Combine has voted. The Kiln lane is closing and its patrols are cleared to turn back any hull that will not leave. This is your notice. There will not be another.

carrier_recon_call.subject: Read the front before it reads you
carrier_recon_call.body: You have a line to us now. Here is the first ask: the relight signal handshakes every beacon it passes, and the Kiln relay logged the timings. Get that record and put it in the right hands. Whoever holds the schedule is ready for what comes; whoever doesn't is surprised by it.

drift_convoy_call.subject: A convoy, if you'll fly it
drift_convoy_call.body: Forty families want out of the ring before the Combine finishes closing the lane. The barge Highcanopy-Nine is slow and it is full. Fly cover for it to Ossuary and the Drift will not forget it.

span_listening.subject: The hub is listening
span_listening.body: The Span beacon is keyed to your transponder. Whatever is running the reactivation has acknowledged you. Come to the core when you are ready to decide what happens to the network.
